claim: Amazon Data Firehose supports delivery to HTTP endpoint destinations across AWS accounts and across AWS Regions, and also to HTTP endpoint destinations outside of AWS Regions, such as an on-premises server. For the cross-Region and outside-AWS cases, additional data transfer charges are added to the delivery costs.

evidence.quote: Amazon Data Firehose supports data delivery to HTTP endpoint destinations across AWS accounts. The Firehose stream and the HTTP endpoint that you choose as your destination can belong to different AWS accounts.

Amazon Data Firehose also supports data delivery to HTTP endpoint destinations across AWS regions. You can deliver data from a Firehose stream in one AWS region to an HTTP endpoint in another AWS region.

You can also delivery data from a Firehose stream to an HTTP endpoint destination outside of AWS regions, for example to your own on-premises server by setting the HTTP endpoint URL to your desired destination. For these scenarios, additional data transfer charges are added to your delivery costs.
